# Antigravity Rail **Stop Antigravity from going silent for 20 minutes, dumping 1,000-line writes, or reverting to English tool labels.** Zero-dependency behavioral guardrails for [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google) — dynamic `AGENTS.md` rules paired with fail-open Hooks and one live side-pane UI. [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-3.0.0-2563EB?style=flat-square)](./CHANGELOG.md) [![Last Commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Lynn-zy/antigravity-rail?style=flat-square&color=059669)](https://github.com/Lynn-zy/antigravity-rail/commits/main) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20%20%C2%B7%200%20deps-111827?style=flat-square)](./package.json) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-64748B?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) **English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## See the Difference
Without Antigravity Rail With Antigravity Rail
Silent for 22 minutes, no opening reply, collapsed tool calls, pure-English tool summaries in a Chinese conversation. Immediate opening reply, localized tool summaries, mid-task progress updates, and clickable workspace file links.
## Why Not Just Static `AGENTS.md`? Static instructions in `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` fade during long multi-step turns. Once the agent stops replying before tools, emits a 1,200-line file write, drops `file:///` links, or slips back to English `toolSummary` labels, static text cannot course-correct until you interrupt it manually. Antigravity Rail pairs dynamically rendered `rules/AGENTS.md` with three lightweight, **fail-open** runtime Hooks (`PostToolUse` and `PreInvocation`) and a **Sidecar UI**: | Capability | Static `AGENTS.md` | Antigravity Rail | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Mid-conversation drift correction | None until you interrupt | Injects one targeted Hook reminder only when a violation happens | | Changing thresholds or toggling rules | Edit Markdown manually | Flip modules, Hooks, and presets live in the side pane | | Runtime footprint | Text only | Pure Node.js ESM (`>= 20`), 0 npm dependencies, never modifies `config.json` | **When you don't need it:** If you work exclusively in English on short single-turn prompts and rarely write files over 500 lines, a few static lines in your own `AGENTS.md` are enough. ## Quick Install Requires **Node.js >= 20** and **Antigravity**. Zero npm packages are installed. ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Lynn-zy/antigravity-rail.git cd antigravity-rail .\scripts\install.ps1 ``` ### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/Lynn-zy/antigravity-rail.git cd antigravity-rail bash ./scripts/install.sh ``` Expected output on a fresh install (`3/3 modules enabled: 500-line write preset / 6-call silent preset`): ```text [antigravity-rail] 安装/更新完成：.../.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-rail [antigravity-rail] 当前状态：3/3 模块已启用（写入 500 行档 / 静默 6 次档） ``` Then open **Antigravity Rail** from Antigravity's side pane to confirm it loaded (on first install, reload Antigravity if the plugin does not appear immediately). The installer copies runtime files into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-rail` without modifying Antigravity's `config.json`. Re-running it to upgrade removes stale `.mjs` files, preserves `config/settings.json`, re-renders `rules/AGENTS.md`, and restarts any running Sidecar automatically via `config/sidecar.pid`.
Custom install directory or uninstall ```powershell # Windows .\scripts\install.ps1 -TargetDir "D:\custom\antigravity-rail" .\scripts\install.ps1 -Uninstall ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux bash ./scripts/install.sh --target "/custom/path/antigravity-rail" bash ./scripts/install.sh --uninstall ``` Uninstalling stops the running Sidecar process (when `config/sidecar.pid` matches a live Node process) before deleting the plugin directory.
## Three Guardrail Modules Each module has two independent toggles in the side pane: - **Module toggle**: Turning it off removes that module's section from `rules/AGENTS.md` and pauses its Hook. - **Hook toggle**: Turning it off keeps the always-on `rules/AGENTS.md` instructions while disabling runtime reminder injection. ### 1. Chunked Write Guard (`write-guard`) Prevents single `write_file` or full-file `edit_file` calls from streaming 1,000+ lines at once, which slows responses and risks mid-stream drops. - `PostToolUse` counts lines and UTF-8 bytes after the write saves to disk—never blocking writes. Failed tool calls and pure deletions (empty `Replacement`) are skipped. - Oversize writes queue per `conversationId` hash in `config/pending/` (30-minute TTL). The next `PreInvocation` injects one reminder (`[antigravity-rail:oversize-reminder]`) and removes the queue file. | Preset | Soft Target (`AGENTS.md`) | `write_file` Limit | `edit_file` Combined Limit (`Target + Replacement`) | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | `700` · Relaxed | ≤ 700 lines | 1100 lines / 64 KB | 1200 lines / 72 KB | | **`500` · Standard (default)** | **≤ 500 lines** | **800 lines / 48 KB** | **900 lines / 56 KB** | | `300` · Conservative | ≤ 300 lines | 500 lines / 28 KB | 600 lines / 36 KB | ### 2. Reply-First & Progress Updates (`responsive-mode`) Stops the agent from firing tools silently at the start of a turn or disappearing behind collapsed "Exploring" streaks, and keeps workspace file mentions clickable. - The first user message is never interrupted; compliant turns pass through silently. - **Next-turn rhythm check**: `PreInvocation` reads the previous turn in `transcript.jsonl`. If the agent ran tools with no opening text, or hit consecutive silent tool calls at the selected preset (`4 · Sensitive` / **`6 · Standard (default)`** / `10 · Relaxed`), it injects `` once. - **Same-turn file-link check**: Mid-turn, if the latest visible reply cites known workspace files (from prior `read_file` / `edit_file` / `write_file` calls or `file:///` links in the session) in plain backticks instead of `[filename](file:///...)`, it injects `` once per turn. - Subagent sessions and background task events are skipped. ### 3. User-Language Tool Summaries (`tool-locale`) Keeps `update_steps` titles (`title`), `update_focus` status messages (`focus`), and `run_command` summaries (`toolSummary`) in the user's language without patching any Antigravity binary. - `rules/AGENTS.md` covers all languages while allowing necessary code identifiers, paths, and CLI commands (such as `npm test` or `git status`). - `PreInvocation` detects 9 non-Latin script families: Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, Thai, Devanagari, Hebrew, and Greek. For short Latin replies like `"ok"` or `"continue"`, it looks back up to 5 user turns. - If a pure-English summary appears in the current turn of a non-Latin chat, it injects `` once before the next model call (max once per user turn). Latin-script chats and subagents stay silent. ## Live Side-Pane Control **Dark Mode**

**Light Mode**

- **Theme & language**: Follows Antigravity's dark and light themes automatically and switches live between English and Chinese in the header. - **Trigger telemetry**: Tracks 4 cumulative counters (`Oversize`, `Write Hints`, `Reply Hints`, `Locale Hints`) plus the latest 3 timestamped triggers from `config/events.jsonl`, with one-click reset. - **Changelog & in-place updates**: Click the version pill to read local [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md). Click **Updates** to check GitHub releases/tags, verify the archive, and swap runtime files in-place with automatic rollback while keeping local settings and stats. > [!NOTE] > Toggling a module or changing a preset rewrites `rules/AGENTS.md`, which invalidates the prompt prefix cache on the next turn. Choose your settings before starting a new conversation. ## Architecture & Safety Guarantees ```mermaid flowchart LR UI["Sidecar Panel UI (EN / 中文)"] --> CFG["config/settings.json"] CFG -->|"re-renders"| RULES["rules/AGENTS.md"] CFG -->|"live thresholds"| WG["write-guard (PostToolUse / PreInvocation)"] CFG -->|"live thresholds"| RM["responsive-mode (PreInvocation)"] CFG -->|"live toggles"| TL["tool-locale (PreInvocation)"] WG -->|"post-write queue"| PEND["config/pending/ (30m TTL)"] WG --> LOG["config/events.jsonl"] RM --> LOG TL --> LOG ``` - **Never blocks disk writes**: Oversize writes always complete; reminders arrive after the write on the next turn. - **Fail-open everywhere**: Malformed stdin, corrupted JSON, missing `transcript.jsonl`, or disk errors return `{}` so Antigravity continues normally. - **Single source of truth**: All thresholds, defaults, and `rules/AGENTS.md` templates live in [`scripts/config.mjs`](./scripts/config.mjs). Side-pane edits write atomically to `config/settings.json` and sync `rules/AGENTS.md`. - **Self-contained footprint**: Settings, pending queues, PID file, and event logs stay inside the plugin directory without touching host binaries or `config.json`. ## Development & Status **Status**: Actively maintained (`v3.0.0`, 2026-11-27), used daily by the author. Bug reports and PRs are welcome via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Lynn-zy/antigravity-rail/issues); full release history is in [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md). Run the built-in Node test suite (**29** unit and CLI tests, zero dependencies): ```bash npm test ``` After editing presets or rule templates in [`scripts/config.mjs`](./scripts/config.mjs), resync the repository's default `rules/AGENTS.md` (do not commit generated `config/settings.json`): ```bash node -e "import('./scripts/config.mjs').then(m => m.syncRulesFromSettings())" ```
Repository layout ```text . ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── hooks.json # Independent Hook declarations (write-guard / responsive-mode / tool-locale) ├── CHANGELOG.md # Release history rendered inside the Sidecar modal ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Plugin icon │ └── readme/ # README screenshots (not copied into runtime install) ├── rules/AGENTS.md # Dynamically rendered guardrail rules ├── scripts/ │ ├── config.mjs # Single source of truth for settings, presets, and AGENTS.md rendering │ ├── stats.mjs # Append-only trigger log (events.jsonl) and reset helper │ ├── transcript.mjs # Tail-window transcript reader and fail-open Hook CLI wrapper │ ├── write-guard-core.mjs # PostToolUse size checks and pending reminder queue │ ├── write-guard-hook.mjs # write-guard Hook entrypoint │ ├── responsive-core.mjs # Next-turn rhythm checks and same-turn file-link checks │ ├── responsive-hook.mjs # responsive-mode Hook entrypoint │ ├── tool-locale-core.mjs # 9-script non-Latin detection and same-turn summary checks │ ├── tool-locale-hook.mjs # tool-locale Hook entrypoint │ ├── install.ps1 # Windows installer, upgrader, and uninstaller │ ├── install.sh # macOS / Linux installer, upgrader, and uninstaller │ └── *.test.mjs # Node built-in test suite (29 tests) └── sidecars/panel/ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar panel declaration ├── main.mjs # Local HTTP server and PID lifecycle for the Sidecar UI ├── panel-logic.mjs # State snapshots, settings updates, stats reset, changelog reader ├── updater.mjs # Zero-dependency GitHub updater with verification and rollback └── index.html # Three-tab bilingual Sidecar UI (auto dark/light theme) ```

latestReleaseNotes:
### Added
- 合并 `responsive-mode` 与 `tool-locale` 能力，整体升级为三合一护栏插件 **Antigravity Rail**（插件 ID：`antigravity-rail`）。
- 新增「先回话与途中汇报」模块（`responsive-mode`）：支持 `4 / 6 / 10` 次三档中途静默阈值、模块总开关、轮间节奏纠偏 Hook 与同轮已知工作区文件可点击链接（`file:///`）纠偏。
- 新增「工具摘要语言匹配」模块（`tool-locale`）：覆盖 `update_steps` 步骤标题（`title`）、`update_focus` 状态（`focus`）与 `run_command` 摘要（`toolSummary`），自动识别 9 种非拉丁文字脚本并支持纯拉丁短回复回溯，提供同轮立即纠偏 Hook（每用户轮次最多一次，允许混排 `npm test` 等技术标识）。
- 侧边栏面板升级为中英双语三标签布局（「分段写入 / 响应汇报 / 摘要语言」），每个模块提供独立的模块总开关（关闭时自动从 `rules/AGENTS.md` 移除对应章节）与 Hook 开关；底部统一展示四项累计触发统计（超限落盘、写入提醒、响应纠偏、摘要纠偏）及最近 3 条带时间戳触发记录，支持一键清零。
- 安装与卸载脚本（`scripts/install.ps1`、`scripts/install.sh`）支持通过 `config/sidecar.pid` 在升级或卸载时自动重启/停止运行中的侧边栏 Sidecar 进程。

### Changed
- 统一配置持久化至 `config/settings.json`（`scripts/config.mjs`），Hook 入口拆分为 `write-guard-hook.mjs`、`responsive-hook.mjs`、`tool-locale-hook.mjs` 并共享 `scripts/transcript.mjs`。
- 面板接口收口为 `POST /api/settings`，更新器与安装脚本同步切换至 `antigravity-rail` 并在安装前清理旧 `.mjs` 脚本残留。
- 重写中英文 README，补充安装前后实拍对比、暗黑/明亮双模式真实侧边栏面板截图与 Mermaid 架构图。

### Fixed
- 修复面板点击「清零」后触发状态未及时刷新的问题，并确保新事件到达时自动收起残留提示。
